Subject: Stellar Solutions — Redwood estimate & deployment options

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and the attachments I promised: the estimate (PDF) plus a short spreadsheet showing deployment options and throughput assumptions. Main points from our conversation: 

- Target: 95th%-ile inference latency <= 200ms for conversational flows, < 100ms for embedding-only endpoints
- Expected steady-state QPS: ~120 requests/minute across three services (chat, rerank, embeddings)
- Two recommended options: Hosted + burst to Dedicated (lower time-to-value) or Dedicated reserved pool for predictable unit cost
- Preliminary monthly estimate and TCO in attached PDF (line items for tokens, reserved capacity, and network egress)

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) I can walk you and Leah through the estimate in a 20–30 minute screen share to make sure the assumptions align with your telemetry
2) If Procurement needs a SOC 2/attestation or a short SOW, we can attach those to the next email
3) If you want, I can provide a short comparison against a Graviton-optimized Dedicated configuration we ran in a similar customer workload

Proposed times (PST) for a quick run-through: Mon 3/13 10:00–10:30am, Tue 3/14 2:00–2:30pm, or Wed 3/15 11:00–11:30am. If none of those work, reply with a couple slots that do.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_Estimate_Stellar_20280310.pdf (PDF, 47KB)], [Attachment: deployment-options.xlsx (XLSX, 9KB)]

Thanks — happy to tailor the numbers if you want to see an aggressive reserved vs. burst comparison.

Best,
